judge.rationale: The candidate never actually implemented the production fix in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. It only created the planning artifact (`.lore/dod.md`), updated `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, and added an acceptance test file (`src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts`). Because the `error instanceof Error` gate in `chatOrchestrator.ts` is untouched, the new acceptance test will fail immediately. Furthermore, the candidate did not update `CHANGELOG.md` as required by the acceptance criteria, and placed the test in a separate `.acceptance.test.ts` file rather than extending `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` like the reference did.
